title: Chapter 740
text:
When the reinforcements led by Sisko arrived on Planet Avitan, the first EsGod doppelganger had already destroyed more than twenty cities, causing heavy casualties. At this time, it was still causing trouble on the planet, giving the surface of Planet Avitan a makeover.

The hyperdrive streamer formed by the Mother Planet fleet dragged a long flame tail and stopped in the outer space of Planet Avitan. Sisko flew out of his spaceship and floated at the front of the fleet. Looking down at the messy surface of the planet, his eyes were filled with endless anger.

A normal Star Pupil Protoss had four arms and three eyes. Their skin was a smooth dark blue, and their internal organs were very different from humans. They had two brains and five hearts, but they did not have any fatal spots. Under the influence of the Evolution Cube, their genes were excellent, and their bones, muscles, and blood vessels were all optimized. Although they were not a rare species in the universe, normal Star Pupil Protoss could still barely survive in the universe with their physical bodies.

Sisko's appearance was very different from his race. He had awakened the atavistic genes, and his appearance was even more ferocious. He had seven eyes on his face, and six of them were in the shape of a rhombus, surrounding the largest main eye in the middle. His pupil was like a black gem, flashing with endless stars as if it contained a galaxy.

He had thick white hair, but it was not real hair but countless hair-like sensory tentacles. A pair of straight white jade horns grew in front of his forehead, and his shoulders, chest, elbows, knees, back, and other parts were covered with natural white exoskeleton, like a simple bone armor. His dark blue skin was filled with dark purple strange patterns, and three pairs of bone limbs that looked like pipes grew out of his back. When they were opened, they looked like wing bones without wing membranes.

Of course, as the leader of a civilization, Sisko did not have the habit of running around naked. He wore a custom-made luxurious robe.

The next moment, Sisko dove toward the surface. The first EsGod doppelganger noticed and stopped in a wasteland, looking up at Sisko landing in front of him.

"EsGod, I know you can hear me. You threw your doppelganger into my territory. Do you want to be my enemy?" Sisko's tone was cold.

He had traveled to other Star Fields before and knew the names of all the Beyond Grade As in the galaxy. He had long recognized that this was EsGod's doppelganger.

The red dot on EsGod doppelganger's face lit up, and his main body's consciousness descended. He controlled the doppelganger to communicate telepathically and said with a faint smile, "You know why I'm here."

"Do you think that as long as you lure me out, you can definitely snatch my treasures?" Sisko said coldly, directly exposing EsGod's intentions.

He was the leader of a civilization, so his reaction was naturally not slow. A notorious Beyond Grade A bruiser in the Central Galaxy had suddenly appeared in the Shattered Star Ring and wreaked havoc in his territory. It was definitely not for fun. The Evolution Cube in his hands was coveted by countless people. When Sisko saw the news on his mother planet, he immediately understood EsGod's intentions. EsGod could only be here for the Evolution Cube.

However, even though he knew that this was a plan to lure him away, he had no other choice. If he did not come, no one would be able to stop the Beyond Grade A EsGod doppelganger from destroying Planet Avitan.

"No matter how strong a person is, as long as they have something to worry about, they will always have a weakness." EsGod doppelganger chuckled.

"Without something worth persevering for, what's the point of being strong?"

Sisko's seven eyes narrowed at the same time, and his psychic energy surged into the sky. His voice became grand, solemn, and ancient, as though it filled the entire world.

"I indeed can't ignore your trap, but as long as I get rid of you quickly, there's no point in luring me away!"

Rumble —

As soon as he said that, EsGod doppelganger punched out with both fists, shooting out black and red energy waves that could destroy the world. The ground cracked, and the continent that was riddled with holes began to tremble violently, gradually tearing apart.

Esper Ability — Dark Energy Destruction!

Sisko ignored the energy waves that were approaching him like a tsunami. His seven eyes shot out light at the same time, and an invisible psychic energy surged up, turning into countless needles that faced the incoming energy waves.

Boom!

The energy wave exploded like fireworks. Although it was dazzling, it was filled with great danger. The scattered energy wave dug out ravines on the ground. Wherever it passed, even the soil was annihilated into powder.

Chi chi chi!

The psychic energy pierced through the Dark Energy Destruction and struck EsGod doppelganger. His body suddenly exploded, scattering into black fog. Within the black fog, there was a red dot flickering. This was the core of EsGod's doppelganger.

The next moment, the black fog condensed back into the red dot, turning back into the doppelganger's appearance, but it was much thinner.

Sisko's psychic energy was just enough to deal the greatest damage to the core of EsGod's doppelganger. Even EsGod's doppelganger would not be able to withstand the power of a Beyond Grade A, not to mention that he had already exhausted a lot of energy.

Boom boom boom!

The moment the two of them exchanged blows, it was as though lightning had struck the earth. The battle between Beyond Grade As was extremely intense, mainly because EsGod's doppelganger did not care about the damage he would cause. It was as though he had pulled out the plug of a reservoir, causing energy to gush out like a flood.

However, Sisko's ability would not cause too much of a shockwave. Although EsGod's doppelganger looked powerful, he was actually not Sisko's opponent at all.

After all, it was just a doppelganger and could not compare to a true Beyond Grade A with a full set of abilities and talents.

Bang!

After a few minutes of intense battle, EsGod's first doppelganger was once again destroyed and barely managed to condense. It was almost unable to maintain the doppelganger's form, and the red dot core flickered as though it would extinguish at any moment.

Just as Sisko was about to chase after EsGod and destroy this doppelganger, he suddenly sensed the appearance of a new Beyond Grade A energy source, and he immediately looked up at the sky.

Just a moment ago, EsGod's third doppelganger, which had been lying in ambush outside Planet Avitan for a long time, finally appeared and was wantonly attacking the support fleet outside the atmosphere.

"With just one doppelganger, I won't be able to stop you." EsGod's main consciousness controlled EsGod's first doppelganger to speak. "However, if there are two of us, it won't be a problem to hold you back for a short period of time. After destroying your fleet, you won't be able to return to your mother planet quickly without a ride."

"You talk too much nonsense!" Sisko's eyes narrowed, and he did not want to waste time talking. He directly used his psychic energy to press EsGod's doppelganger onto the ground.

In truth, Sisko was not too worried. He was not too worried about the Evolution Cube being stolen. He felt that EsGod only knew that the Evolution Cube was a Universal Treasure but most likely did not know what the Evolution Cube was.

The Evolution Cube was very strange, and its size was huge. He had studied it for so long but still could not carry it around. Unless he snatched it by force, it would not be possible for it to be stolen. He dared to leave his mother planet temporarily to provide support because he was confident in this aspect.

Of course, Sisko did not know EsGod's true trump card.

…

Star Pupil God Race's mother planet.

While Sisko was being held back by the two doppelganger, EsGod's second doppelganger finally moved. Using its regional teleportation ability, it brought Colin, Orozen, and the others to the location where the Evolution Cube was stored.

Strong light!

Extremely dazzling light!

When everyone gradually adapted to the dazzling light around them, they sized up their surroundings.

This was a strange space, filled with white, sticky liquid all around them, isolated by the light green shield released by EsGod's second doppelganger.

"What is this place?" Orozen was curious.

"The outer layer of the Star Pupil God Race's mother planet," EsGod's second doppelganger said calmly.

The Evolution Cube was hidden by Sisko in the core layer of his mother planet and covered by Sisko's psychic barrier, blocking most detection and sensing abilities. If not for the Evolutionary Civilization recording the method to locate the Evolution Cube, EsGod's doppelganger would not have been able to directly teleport to the destination.

EsGod's second doppelganger identified it and used its psychic Esper Ability to dissolve the barrier left by Sisko.

The next moment, a gigantic metallic object appeared before everyone's eyes.

They did not know how big this object was. They only knew that they could only see one side of the Evolution Cube and could not see the end of this side.

"This thing is too big." Colin's pupils constricted.

Orozen's face was filled with curiosity. He reached out to touch the Evolution Cube but did not touch its physical body. His hand reached into the cube without any hindrance as if the Evolution Cube was just a projection without a physical body.

The physical form of the Evolution Cube was very strange. It was between matter and energy and could not be touched through normal means.

"According to the data, as long as one walks into the Evolution Cube, they will evolve inside. This is the simplest way to use it." Orozen was tempted.

Colin was also tempted, but he still remembered the mission and said, "Don't waste time. Quickly use the device to contain it."

Everyone hurriedly took out a palm-sized silver cube and handed it to Colin.

This was a supporting device for the Evolution Cube that EsGod had built based on the information left behind by the Evolutionary Civilization. It was like a container for storing water, and its only use was to store the huge Evolution Cube so that it could be carried around.

This was a special technology of the Evolutionary Civilization that had been lost for a long time. Only EsGod, who had the data of this civilization, could create such a device!

Without this device, it would have been almost impossible to steal the Evolution Cube.

Colin raised the silver cube and activated it.

Ding!

The silver cube suddenly lit up with a gentle light.

The huge Evolution Cube seemed to have sensed something and shook violently, producing some kind of particle resonance on its surface. The next moment, a black ray of light suddenly shot out from the surface of the Evolution Cube that was facing everyone, connecting to the silver cube like a pipe.

Then, the Evolution Cube started to turn itself into a pure energy form and slowly 'stuffed' itself into the silver cube along the pipe. It was as if it had finally found its home.

The size of the Evolution Cube in the outside world gradually shrank, and the silver cube seemed to have a straw inserted into it, drinking the Evolution Cube leisurely.

Seeing that the device was working correctly, Colin heaved a sigh of relief. "The containment process will take a few minutes. We have plenty of time."

As soon as he said that, dense white light clusters suddenly appeared at the end of their vision and rushed toward them. If not for the fact that they were all Supers with outstanding eyesight, they would not have been able to notice these inconspicuous light clusters in the bright light.

"What are those light clusters?" Colin's expression changed, and a huge sense of danger appeared in his heart.

The EsGod doppelganger suddenly spoke. "Sisko indeed had a backup plan. These are all his psychic energy. Every light cluster is equivalent to a Beyond Grade A psychic attack. This is a method used to protect the Evolution Cube and will attack all intruders. You guys focus on containing the Evolution Cube. I'll block these psychic attacks!"

The power of each of these active psychic energy light balls was equivalent to the one-time psychic weapon that Han Xiao had endured before. At this moment, more and more light balls appeared continuously, swarming toward this group of people as if there was no end to them.

The EsGod doppelganger opened an invisible mental shield and covered everyone.

Bang! Bang! Bang!

The activated psychic light balls crashed into the shield one after another. It was like a rainstorm hitting the surface of a lake. Countless ripples appeared on the surface of the shield.

The red dot core of the EsGod doppelganger dimmed at a visible speed. Enduring so many Beyond Grade A psychic attacks, his energy was being consumed rapidly.

"Hurry up … hurry up …"

Everyone was extremely anxious and stared at the silver cube slowly absorbing the Evolution Cube like a straw drinking milk. They could not wait to squeeze the Evolution Cube into a ball and stuff it directly into the cube.

They were very clear that once the EsGod doppelganger could not hold on, they would be dead for sure.

The waiting time felt like years. Thankfully, although the Evolution Cube's physical form was weird, it was still a whole. When the silver cube absorbed enough of the Evolution Cube's volume, it began to have a huge attractive force toward the rest of the cube, and the absorption speed skyrocketed.

Finally, the last bit of the Evolution Cube turned into energy and was stuffed into the silver cube. The absorption was finally complete, and the silver cube turned black.

This was the complete Evolution Cube!

"It's done!" Colin hurriedly shouted.

"Go!" The EsGod doppelganger could no longer hold on and used the last of his energy to teleport Colin and the others back to the spaceship. He then hurriedly cut off the teleportation gate.

The next moment, this doppelganger could no longer maintain the shield and was drowned by the endless psychic energy light clusters, directly exploding.

However, his mission had been completed, which was to protect his subordinates until they stole the Evolution Cube.

The doppelganger's energy was limited, and he could only rely on these subordinates to cross the desolate universe belt and bring the item back to the Fallen Ark. EsGod's main body did not dare leave the Central Galaxy casually. The three Universal Civilizations were watching him, and if his main body moved, he would not be able to hide this operation, which would become even more troublesome.

…

Colin and the others were teleported back to the spaceship, and before they could say anything, their attention was attracted by the buzzing alarm of the spaceship.

"Sh * t, our spaceship has been discovered. The Star Pupil mother planet has sent a fleet to attack us!"

Everyone's expression changed.

The three 'Light Fox' spaceships were surrounded by a large number of Star Pupil battleships, and their shields were being baptized by the light cannons.

When they stole the Evolution Cube, Sisko had already sensed it and hurriedly ordered the army stationed on the mother planet to search the surrounding space. As the EsGod doppelganger was destroyed, the three spaceships lost their concealment shield and were finally discovered by the Star Pupil God Race. They were immediately surrounded and attacked.

"Run!"

Colin did not have the time to observe the Evolution Cube and hurriedly piloted the spaceship to avoid the attack.

The three spaceships fled in different directions, and very soon, one of them was destroyed in midair.

The remaining two spaceships relied on their powerful engines to escape at the last moment. The hull of the spaceship was severely damaged, and the exterior armor was damaged everywhere.

Colin panted heavily, and only when he entered hyperdrive mode did his tense body relax.

"We escaped. With our speed, the enemy won't be able to catch up," Colin said in a low voice.

"Activate the spaceship self-check and calculate the damage," Colin said with a deep voice.

The spaceship's artificial intelligence replied intermittently.

"Buzz … self-check … Hull damage 63%, shield generator close to destruction, energy furnace moderately damaged, power output reduced by 42% … Buzz … Cluster thrusters 38% damaged, fourth and sixth engines close to destruction, automatic repair equipment malfunctioning … Immediate repair of the spaceship is recommended. With the current state of the spaceship, it will not be able to support long hyperdrive."

Orozen clenched his teeth. "Stealing something from a Beyond Grade A, how exciting."

"No matter what, the item is already in our hands."

Colin glanced at the palm-sized Evolution Cube and said, "The spaceship is unable to cross Star Fields in its current state. We just have to find a safe place to repair the spaceship, and we can return to complete our mission."

"Hmm, I know a planet where spaceships can be repaired. It's not controlled by any civilization and is very safe. Furthermore, it's at the edge of the Shattered Star Ring. As long as the spaceship is repaired there, we can leave this Star Field. I escaped from the Shattered Star Ring from there sixty years ago," Orozen said.

Hearing the name of that planet, Colin checked the star map and nodded.

"Okay, that place is very far from the Star Pupil God Race. We can use our speed to shake off the pursuers for a long time and buy enough time for us to repair the spaceship."

They would only dare to cross Star Fields after repairing the spaceship. Otherwise, if the spaceship malfunctioned in the desolate universe belt between Star Fields, they would be in dire straits.

This' Light Fox 'spaceship immediately changed direction, turning into a stream of light and disappearing on the other side of the universe.

…

Planet Avitan.

The last EsGod doppelganger was destroyed and turned into a cloud of black mist.

Sisko retracted his psychic energy, brushed the dust off his clothes, and looked up at the sky with a solemn expression.

"He really stole the Evolution Cube. I didn't expect EsGod to have detailed information about the Evolution Cube. I miscalculated …"

The three EsGod doppelgangers were equivalent to three Beyond Grade As working together, and he was only one person, so it was understandable that EsGod had succeeded.

This was also why EsGod was so troublesome.

However, Sisko was very calm and did not panic. He narrowed his eyes and muttered, "Although you succeeded, don't think that you can take the Evolution Cube away from me so easily."

Although Sisko did not have the manual for the Evolution Cube, he had the Evolution Cube for so long and had some results. Just like how Austin had control over the Palace of Hidden Spells, Sisko had guarded the Evolution Cube for so many years and had almost turned it into his own 'magic treasure'.

He had formed a mental connection with the Evolution Cube, so even if the Evolution Cube was not by his side, he could use it to increase his psychic energy.

At the same time, he had left a mark on the Evolution Cube, so even if it was far away, he could sense its location.

In his senses, the coordinates of the Evolution Cube were moving rapidly, marking the coordinates of Colin and the others.

Want to run after stealing?

Not so easy!

Sisko tapped his forehead and sent a telepathic message to his subordinates.

"Prepare the fastest spaceship for me. I'll chase after those thieves!"

Genius remembered the address of this station in one second. Translator: Atlas Studios Editor: Atlas Studios
